title: 回路の桜は、零時の終着駅で散る
author: 霧島 探偵社

en.title: The Circuit's Cherry Blossoms Fall at the Midnight Terminal
en.premise: "I want you to show me the 'death mask' of this memory." In a back-alley bar, a client hands over blood-stained data, her wet coat swaying. It is proof that the consciousness of a girl who should be dead has become entwined within the city's infrastructure. I step into the depths of a city shrouded in electronic mist, only to find the gruesome remains of broken androids, scattering like falling cherry blossoms.

zh.title: 回路的樱花，在零时的终着站凋零
zh.premise: “我想让你，看看这段记忆的‘死相’。”——在小巷深处的酒吧里，委托人摇晃着湿透的大衣下摆，递出了一份混杂着血迹的数据。那是证明一名本该死去的少女，其意识已潜入城市基础设施中的证据。我踏入了被电子迷雾笼罩的城市深处。在那里等待着我的，是如樱花瓣般漫天飞舞、破碎安卓机器人的残骸。

prediction_results.question: 次に何が起こる？

桜の花びらが警告のメッセージか
